details:
Betina’s Time Capsule: The Future Is Built by Remembering the Past is an AI-generated animated educational video that introduces children ages 6 to 7 to the history of NASA’s space exploration equipment. Through the adventures of Betina, a friendly French Bulldog, children discover the purpose, functions, and scientific contributions of equipment left on the Moon and Mars, such as the Lunar Roving Vehicles and the Sojourner rover.

The project works through short, colorful animations and simple storytelling. Betina travels through space, meets different pieces of NASA equipment, and explains their stories using language adapted to young children.

Its main benefits are making science more accessible, stimulating curiosity, encouraging scientific thinking, and helping children understand and remember scientific information. It also provides teachers, parents, and schools with an additional educational resource.

The intended impact is to inspire future generations to explore science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM), while preserving the stories and scientific legacy of NASA's missions. Additionally, the project raises awareness about the equipment and objects that remain on the Moon and Mars, encouraging more responsible space exploration.

To develop the project, we used Dreamina AI to generate Betina's character, space environments, and animated scenes. We also used ChatGPT to develop and refine the script, along with official NASA sources to research and verify scientific information. Computers with internet access and video-editing tools were also part of the development process.

The creative aspect of our project is its storytelling approach. Instead of presenting scientific facts through traditional explanations, we transform real space exploration history into an adventure led by an adorable and relatable character. Each piece of equipment becomes part of a story, making complex information easier and more entertaining for children.

Throughout development, our team considered the target audience's age, attention span, reading comprehension, and learning needs. We also prioritized scientific accuracy, simple vocabulary, visual appeal, accessibility, and the feasibility of creating animations with available AI tools.
